summary: Expert agents reverse-engineer CodeTrading ML-trading-indicator method + design an honest ML indicator for FRIDAY (lightgbm, triple-barrier, purged CV, no leakage)

spec.pipeline:
EXACT PIPELINE for ml_indicator.py (env-verified; NOT the video's leaky recipe). Run interpreter = C:\Users\Radhi\MT5\.venv\Scripts\python.exe ONLY (lightgbm 4.6.0 + sklearn 1.8.0 live there; both MISSING from system python). skfolio is NOT installed anywhere (verified ModuleNotFoundError in venv AND system) -> the spec MUST NOT import skfolio; vendor a ~40-LOC PurgedWalkForwardCV instead (or `.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install skfolio` as a prereq, but don't depend on it).

(1) FEATURES (closed bars only, identical funcs to the 40 voters): reuse chart_read._ema/_rsi/_adx_di/_macd/_roc/_cci/_williams_r/_supertrend and advanced_indicators.vote(name,...) over REGISTRY. Feature vector at bar i uses ONLY close[:i+1] (causal). Mix the bounded +1/-1/0 votes (the engine's pre-engineered signals) WITH a few continuous features LightGBM can split on that the buckets throw away: rsi value, adx value, macd_hist/atr, atr-normalized log-returns over [1,3,5,10] bars, range/atr, ewma realized vol, hurst_regime() bucket from quant_gates, session one-hot (Asian/London/NY) + hour sin/cos. Pin the ordered feature-name list in the sidecar meta.json; predict-time mismatch => abstain.

(2) LABELS = triple-barrier, vol-scaled, COST-AWARE (NOT video's sign-of-future-return). From bar i: TP = entry + K_TP*ATR_i, SL = entry - K_SL*ATR_i (K_TP~2.0, K_SL~1.0 ~ genome TP/SL geometry), vertical = i+H with H == HORIZON (use 8 to match indicator_accuracy.py, or sweep {8,12,24} per TF). Scan ONLY i+1..i+H, label = first barrier touched, profit barrier = WIN(1)/not-WIN(0). SUBTRACT the real per-bar spread (same spread series the genome backtester uses) from the profit barrier so the label is NET. Record t1 = resolution bar index (needed for purging). Drop the last H rows (no valid future).

(3) SAMPLE WEIGHTS = average uniqueness (de Prado). Triple-barrier labels overlap because windows overlap; weight each sample 1/concurrency so clustered near-duplicate events don't inflate effective signal. Pass as LGBMClassifier sample_weight. This is the silent killer the video ignores entirely.

(4) MODEL = lightgbm LGBMClassifier, binary, SMALL/regularized (we want a weak honest edge, not a memorizer): max_depth<=3-5, num_leaves 15-31, min_child_samples 100-200, n_estimators 80-300, learning_rate 0.03, subsample 0.7-0.8, colsample_bytree 0.6-0.7, reg_lambda 1-2, is_unbalance=True (NEVER SMOTE time series -> synthesizes leakage). Add monotone_constraints as domain guardrails: rising spread => never-higher win-prob (-1), higher confluence/net-vote => +1. One model per (symbol, tf).

(5) VALIDATION = PURGED + EMBARGOED walk-forward (replaces the video's shuffled train_test_split, which is THE leak). Vendor PurgedWalkForwardCV: PURGE any train sample whose [i,t1] overlaps a test sample; EMBARGO a gap >= H bars after each test block. Score per fold on the TEST slice only: directional hit-rate of the hard call (same yardstick as indicator_accuracy.py), lift = mean_oos_hit - 0.5, plus ROC-AUC and balanced_accuracy (sklearn, never hand-rolled). Report mean AND worst fold.

(6) MONEY GATE = convert OOS probs (>threshold tuned for precision, ~0.55) into triple-barrier trades, subtract REAL per-bar spread in R, build per-trade R series, run quant_gates.deflated_sharpe_ratio(R, n_trials) where n_trials = #(symbol x tf x H x K x threshold) configs tried, and probabilistic_sharpe_ratio(R). PASS only if ALL: mean OOS AUC >= 0.55 AND >= baseline(majority/ADX-trend)+0.03; OOS positive in >= 75% of folds; >= 30-40 OOS trades; PF >= 1.2 net of spread; deflated_sharpe_ratio > 0.5 and PSR > 0.95. Expect MOST configs to FAIL. AUC != PnL after spread.
spec.daemon_design:
DAEMON ml_indicator.py — windowless, single-instance, $0/local, failure-safe (every layer degrades to "no vote"). Lives at C:\Users\Radhi\MT5\ml_indicator.py; run via .venv python; respawn line added to start_friday_trading_full.ps1 tier-2 (intelligence learners) OR the scheduled-tasks runner. PID+ts lock like sdk_scheduler.py at r_native_v2\data\ml_indicator.lock (steal if stale > 300s) to block respawn duplicates.

TWO loops in one process:
- PREDICT loop (every ~90s, cheap): load cached joblib model + sidecar meta; pull latest bars; DROP the forming bar (close[:-1]) so live features == training features; compute feat_row on the last CLOSED bar; write the vote JSON. If model/meta missing, corrupt, or feats list != current FEATS, or prob NaN/inf -> abstain (write nothing).
- RETRAIN loop (every ~6h or once/day off-session, staggered per symbol to spread CPU): copy_rates_from_pos last 3000-5000 bars; build (X, triple_barrier_y, t1, sample_w); run the Step-5 purged-CV to get OOS lift + the Step-6 money gate verdict; fit final model on all data; atomic-write model + meta; merge the 'ml' accuracy entry.

OUTPUT SCHEMA (two files, atomic tmp+os.replace):
1) Vote file r_native_v2\data\ml_pred_{symbol}_{tf}.json = {"symbol","tf","ts":epoch,"prob_up":0.xxxx,"vote": +1 if prob>=0.55 / -1 if <=0.45 / 0 else (deadband -> abstain when unsure),"hash":model_hash,"oos_lift":x}.
2) Accuracy merge into the EXISTING r_native_v2\data\indicator_accuracy_{symbol}.json under its "accuracy" dict: accuracy["ml"] = {"hit_rate": round(0.5+lift,3), "lift": lift, "votes": oos_n}. IF the money gate FAILED, still write the entry but with lift<=0 so the learned factor crushes it to the 0.2 floor (self-demotion). Persist model to r_native_v2\data\ml_models\{symbol}_{tf}.joblib + sidecar {symbol}_{tf}.meta.json {feats order, train range, oos_lift, dsr, psr, hash, lgbm/sklearn versions}.

HOW chart_read CONSUMES IT (one additive edit, ZERO weighting-logic change): in chart_read.read_local() insert a try/except near the advanced_indicators block (peer of the news/talib blocks), read ml_pred_{symbol}_{tf}.json, check freshness (ts within ~2*HORIZON bars, e.g. < 3600s), and call the EXISTING cast("ml", d["vote"], 1.5) (BASE peer of supertrend/ichimoku). VERIFIED at chart_read.py: cast() at line 288 multiplies the base weight by _lf.get(name,1.0); _learned_factors() at line 240 reads indicator_accuracy_{symbol}.json and converts measured lift -> factor = clamp(1 + lift*10, 0.2, 2.0) with a votes>=40 floor. So the moment ml_indicator.py writes accuracy["ml"], the ML voter is auto-weighted by the IDENTICAL measured-lift machine as rsi/macd/supertrend. Stale/missing/corrupt file -> the whole block is in try/except -> system behaves exactly as today (40 voters). NOTE: indicator_accuracy.py's own writer uses votes>=40 floor too, but its weight formula is lift*12 clamp 2.5 (slightly different from chart_read's 1+lift*10 clamp 2.0) — chart_read._learned_factors is the one that actually weights live, so target that contract.

ROSTER: train only symbols that already have indicator_accuracy_*.json; start with symbol_universe.json enabled(2)+gauntlet(7) basket, default --symbols XAUUSDm,BTCUSDm,US30m, --tf M15; expand by config. Keep ML OUT of the genome trainer (market_gate._vote) until standalone OOS lift is proven positive on several symbols — the genome needs a leak-free vote at every historical bar (walk-forward refit), a much bigger build.
guardrails: LEAKAGE-PROOF VALIDATION OR NOTHING: never sklearn train_test_split / shuffle / plain KFold on overlapping-window samples (that is the video's #1 lie that prints 90-99% fake AUC). Use the vendored PurgedWalkForwardCV: purge train samples whose [i,t1] overlaps test, embargo >= HORIZON bars after each test block. skfolio is NOT installed (verified) so do not import it.

LABEL-SHUFFLE NULL CONTROL every retrain: permute y, refit, re-run OOS — mean AUC MUST collapse to ~0.50. If it stays >0.55 on shuffled labels, a feature or the split leaks. Refuse to ship until it collapses.
EMBARGO-SENSITIVITY CHECK: compare embargo=0 vs embargo>=H. A large AUC drop when embargo is added == serial-correlation leak you were riding. Report both.

SCORE MONEY, NOT ACCURACY: a 0.56-AUC model can still lose after spread. Gate on net-R PF>=1.2 + deflated_sharpe_ratio(R, n_trials=#configs)>0.5 + PSR>0.95, n_trials = every symbol x tf x H x K x threshold combination tried (multiple-testing / grid-search selection-bias guard). Raw Sharpe passing but DSR failing == luck.

FORMING-BAR DISCIPLINE: predict() must drop the current incomplete bar (close[:-1]); train and live must call the IDENTICAL feat_row on the same WIN; pin feature order in meta.json and abstain on any mismatch. Same-bar leakage silently inflates live accuracy.

FIT SCALERS/ENCODERS INSIDE EACH TRAIN FOLD ONLY: any global StandardScaler/PCA/feature-selection fit before the split bleeds the test distribution into the past. No centered rolling windows, no repainting indicators (zig-zag, future-anchored VWAP), no future-filled NaNs.

NEVER let ML override — it is ONE voter at BASE 1.5 and ALL real influence is routed through _learned_factors (clamp 0.2-2.0). LightGBM probabilities are uncalibrated, so use them only for a bucketed +1/0/-1 vote with a 0.45/0.55 deadband; do not size weight by prob magnitude. A great-backtest/zero-OOS-lift model self-demotes to the 0.2 floor automatically.

FAIL OPEN, NEVER FAIL DANGEROUS: MT5/bars missing, model corrupt, version/feature mismatch, NaN prob, stale prediction, daemon crash -> abstain (no ml key, chart_read try/except skips). Worst case == today's 40-voter behavior. DEMO-only, behind the existing kill-switch + night-discipline gates; advisory first (logged, weighted by lift) before it can meaningfully move size.

WALK-FORWARD RECENCY: rerun on rolling 60/120/180d windows (genome_walkforward convention); require the edge to survive in the MAJORITY of windows and >= 30-40 OOS trades/window. A model that learns one regime then dies must be caught and demoted. Watch any single feature importance > ~40% (often a leak) and a train-vs-OOS AUC gap > ~0.15 (memorization).

ALWAYS WRITE A VERDICT JSON (pass OR fail), like phase-09 gate_regime.py; export the model only on a full Step-6 PASS. Reproduce-the-leak-first is optional but instructive: running the video pipeline as-is then watching AUC drop from ~0.9 to ~0.52 under the honest protocol IS the look-ahead you removed.
spec.most_important: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT THING: the validation must be purged + embargoed, and the model must be judged in MONEY (net-of-spread deflated Sharpe) — not classifier accuracy. Everything else (features, LightGBM, the voter wiring) is plumbing FRIDAY already has. The video's entire reported edge is an artifact of two leaks — overlapping triple-barrier/horizon labels split with a shuffled train_test_split, and accuracy reported instead of PnL. Fix those two and the honest OOS edge on M1/M5 gold/FX is realistically ~0.50-0.55 AUC, which usually does NOT survive spread. So the correct mental model is: this is a DISCIPLINE/CONTEXT filter (one more self-judged voter that mostly learns "when to abstain / when it's ranging"), exactly matching FRIDAY's proven REAL-EDGE finding (the edge is discipline, not a new oracle) and the vol_regime "range-not-direction" result. Build it to self-demote: wire accuracy["ml"] into the existing _learned_factors (verified clamp 1+lift*10 -> 0.2..2.0, votes>=40) so a no-edge model auto-mutes to 0.2 with zero human intervention. If you cannot make the label-shuffle null test collapse to ~0.50 AUC, you have a leak, not an edge — stop and fix it before a single line touches chart_read.
